note: start/end are seconds after the start of the white SYNC flash

titleCards.text: Batch 5: legend blades and falling stars
Batch 8: fire and the first stares
Batch 9: great stares and the clear eye
Batch 11: insect swarms, lines and guards
Batch 14: bone armour, dances and bullets
Batch 15: bone binds and the shadow's reach
Batch 16: shadow binds, blades and dome
Batch 17: swelling bodies and heavy blows
Batch 20: ANBU tracking, lightning and silence
Batch 21: ANBU echoes, earth, barriers and stealth
Batch 22: ANBU field medicine and assassin's arts
Batch 23: ANBU: questioning and the mind
Batch 24: masked guard, binds and burning

skippedScenes: Batch 7: sparrows, chakra dragon, enclosures: only 9 of 10 hero sequences started
Batch 28: three dragon stances: only 7 of 9 hero sequences started
cameraHeld: 255 of 255 clips held the zoom (measured from the rendered camera size)

clips.label: Monolith: Satetsu World Method
clips.desc: Branching spikes of iron sand tear through a huge area.

clips.label: Forced Dimension
clips.desc: Force the full Ranzatsu curse on every enemy in an area for two minutes.

clips.label: Yasumichū Jigen: Closed Dimension
clips.desc: Shut off the sense of pain for a minute.

clips.label: Saisokufūin (summon seal)
clips.desc: A summoning seal snaps you to a spot in a flash.
clips.treeLabel: Kekkai to Makimono Fūin (Barriers and scroll seals)

clips.label: Keiretsu Shingō (maximum length)
clips.desc: Unfold the blade to its full length and cut through everyone in a long line. (Needs The clockwork blade in hand.)

clips.label: Kidachi (Chakra cutting)
clips.desc: Cut through one enemy's chakra: their techniques are sealed for a while. (Needs Kibaō in hand.)

clips.label: Kumo Soushi: Storm Cloud
clips.desc: Make a storm cloud and send it where you aim. It lasts a day and grows with the Tempest rank. Up to two at a time; a third replaces the oldest. At O-Dai Ryuugan the cloud itself throws lightning at enemies under it. The Kumo techniques strike from these clouds. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Kubo Buruto: Cloud Bolt
clips.desc: Lightning drops out of one of your clouds onto a target under it. No line of sight needed. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Arashi Ryuu: Storm Dragon
clips.desc: A dragon of storm pours out of your nearest cloud in a line to the target, hitting and throwing back everyone along the way. The target must be within 30 cells of one of your clouds. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Arashi Yari: Storm Spears
clips.desc: Spears of lightning rain down over the whole of one of your clouds for a few seconds. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Kuchiyose: Kishinryuu
clips.desc: Summon the storm dragon for one fight (about two in-game hours). It can be drafted, and lightning falls on enemies around it. Needs the O-Dai Ryuugan. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Sansutomu no Kishinryuu
clips.desc: Call down the great storm: rain, wind and lightning over a huge area around the user for 25 seconds. Most bolts seek out enemies, but it hits EVERYONE caught in it, your own people included. The user collapses afterwards, unconscious for about half a day. Needs the O-Dai Ryuugan. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Tenshou Yodan: Weather Prediction
clips.desc: The Ryuugan reads the sky: how long the current weather lasts, what comes next (and it does come next), and any storms, fallout or other events already in the air.

clips.label: Osore no Tatsu: Fear of the Dragon
clips.desc: A lightning-filled downpour over a wide area for 20 seconds: bolts keep striking everyone soaked in it, allies included, and enemies caught in it may flee in terror. The weather turns to rain. Needs the O-Dai Ryuugan. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Kishinryuu Fukai Panchi: Deep Strike
clips.desc: Drive lightning into the ground; it travels under cover and erupts beneath the target. Needs no line of sight. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Higashi Jinrai: Thunderclap
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile KZ_ThunderclapBolt: painted flight none, flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 32, impacts 0]  [storm starts 0 (last KZ_UndergroundStrike_1)]
clips.desc: A bolt that locks the target's muscles: little damage, but it stuns. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Arashi Ya: Storm Arrow
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile KZ_StormArrowBolt: painted flight none, flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 52, impacts 0]  [storm starts 0 (last KZ_UndergroundStrike_1)]
clips.desc: A quick arrow of lightning. Its upgrades fold in Higashi Raikou Dageki and Higashi Boufuu: a wind-sharpened bolt that also cuts. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Arashi Tama: Storm Bullets
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile KZ_StormBullet: painted flight none, flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 66, impacts 0]  [storm starts 0 (last KZ_UndergroundStrike_1)]
clips.desc: A burst of small storm bullets: three at C-rank, six at B-rank. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Erekutoronikku Shingai: Burnout
clips.desc: Overload a turret or mechanoid. One you have hijacked burns out completely: a turret is destroyed, a mech takes double damage. Needs the Ryuugan active.

clips.label: Dendou Yousuru: Hijack
clips.desc: Take over an enemy turret for 15 seconds, or send an enemy mechanoid into a frenzy against its own side. Needs the Ryuugan active.

clips.label: Ryuugan: Dendou
clips.desc: The Ryuugan follows the current through every enemy turret and mechanoid on the map and reveals what is around them.

clips.label: Kokyuu no Ryu: Dragon Breath
clips.desc: Breathe out a cone of storm. Daikokyuu no Ryu, the great breath, reaches much further and stuns. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Kishinryuu Hanmaa: Storm Hammer
clips.desc: A short, wide blast of wind and lightning that throws everyone in front of the user back. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Beikoku Saikuron: Cyclone
clips.desc: A cyclone that sits on a spot for a few seconds and keeps cutting whoever is caught in it. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Gufuu Dageki: Lightning Hurricane
clips.desc: A hurricane of wind with lightning raining down inside it. Needs the O-Dai Ryuugan. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Raiton ha Arashi: Lightning Leaf Storm
clips.desc: A storm of electrified leaves sits on a spot for ten seconds: the leaves cut and the lightning in them shocks everyone inside, allies included. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Uetto Senpuu: Whirlwind Screen
clips.why: the enemy's throws reached the caster (6 blows) and none struck the barrier: check its protection  [storm starts 0 (last KZ_LeafStorm_1)]
clips.desc: Raise a whirlwind around the user that catches incoming shots for a few seconds. Shots from inside still go out. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Domu no Kishinryuu: Storm Dome
clips.why: the enemy's throws struck the barrier (3 stopped)
clips.desc: A dome of storm on a chosen spot. It stops enemy shots for twenty seconds and shocks enemies who stand inside it. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Senpuku: Ambush Orbs
clips.desc: Leave a storm orb on the ground. It waits up to a day and goes off when an enemy comes close; the blast hurts anyone nearby, allies too. Three kinds, switched with the button next to it: Senpuku Rakurai (lightning orb, cutting wind), Suimakihige (water orb, a shocking spray that stuns) and Ichijin (wind orb, a water burst that throws people back). Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Arashi Bunshin no Jutsu: Storm Clone
clips.why: affected target, something appeared  [storm starts 1 (last KZ_StormClone_1), clones made 1]
clips.desc: A clone of the user made of lightning, water and wind. It copies their looks, skills, weapon and clothes and fights for about thirty seconds, then bursts in a storm blast. It bursts early if it falls. Nothing it carries is left behind. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Ryuugan
clips.desc: The Kazeraikou dragon eye. Turn it on to see further and aim faster. It opens in three stages as the user grows in ninjutsu: Chibi Ryuugan, Ryuugan and O-Dai Ryuugan. Each stage of the eye opens the next rank of the Tempest channel.

clips.label: Arashi no Kiero
clips.desc: Channeling of the Tempest: hold one element in each hand, ready to throw. Drains chakra while on, and every storm technique needs it active. Its rank (C to S) decides which techniques the user can learn. Each rank needs the matching stage of the Ryuugan.

clips.label: Raiun Kyakuriki: Cloud Stepping
clips.desc: While this is on, the user (and any ally who also has it on) runs on the storm inside your clouds: much faster while standing in one.

clips.label: Arashi Kishi: Storm Knight
clips.desc: Armour made of the three elements. Strong against blades, blows and heat, but heavy. Needs Arashi no Kiero active.

clips.label: Kishinryuu Kenbu: Sword Dance
clips.desc: Wrap the user's weapon in wind and lightning: harder, faster, surer melee hits for a while.

clips.label: Nine Swords Asura
clips.desc: Nine phantom blades fall on everything in front of the user. (Needs a sword.)

clips.label: Dragon Twister
clips.desc: A spinning tornado of blades around the user. (Needs a sword.)

clips.label: Tenkū Ryūsen (Heaven-Soaring Dragon Flash)
clips.desc: A two-stage draw-cut: the first cut pulls the air, the second ends the fight.

clips.label: Ryūtsui (Dragon hammer)
clips.desc: Bring the giant blade down with a dragon of fire: a crater opens around you. (Needs Ryūgeki in hand.)

clips.label: Ryūraisen (dragon thunder)
clips.desc: Call a dragon of red lightning down on one enemy far away. (Needs Ryūgeki in hand.)

clips.label: Angetsu Retsu (Dark moon rift)
clips.desc: A black crescent rift opens in the air and tears at everything near it. (Needs Kibaō in hand.)

clips.label: Tetsu Rasetsu (Iron Demon Fury)
clips.desc: Glide to one enemy and unleash a storm of blows in an instant. Needs empty hands.

clips.label: Nagareboshi (shooting star)
clips.desc: Leap and fall on one enemy like a shooting star. (Needs Hoshigiri in hand.)

clips.label: Starfall
clips.desc: Bolts of force rain down on an area for eight seconds.

clips.label: Seigi no Hoshi (Star of Justice)
clips.desc: Leap high and come crashing down like a falling star. Hits harder from the saddle, more on a big mount. Needs a melee weapon.

clips.label: Ki Hōkiboshi (Chakra Comet)
clips.desc: A fast orb of chakra punches through the target.

clips.label: Batch 5: legend blades and falling stars
clips.scene: Batch 5: legend blades and falling stars

clips.label: Suzaku: Phoenix
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile NF_Phoenix: painted flight SigPhoenixFlight (4 frames, on True), flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 80, impacts 0]  [storm starts 1 (last NF_Phoenix_1)]
clips.desc: A phoenix of fire dives onto the target.

clips.label: King-Sized Rainbow Dragon
clips.desc: A dragon of molten candy sweeps through a wide arc.

clips.label: Katon: True Hydra
clips.desc: Many heads of fire sweep a broad arc in front of the user.

clips.label: Suiton: Megamouth Shark
clips.desc: A colossal shark of water sweeps through a wide arc, swallowing everything.

clips.label: Crescent Dragons
clips.desc: Four scrolls circle the user and loose a 360° storm of weapons that pierces even stone. Everyone around is hit, allies too.

clips.label: Rairyū no Ikari (Wrath of the Thunder Dragon)
clips.desc: Leap and crash down on an area with lightning. Hits harder from the saddle, more on a big mount. Needs a melee weapon.

clips.label: Are Kuruu Kuma no Yamera Renai Kake (Unstoppable Lope of the Raging Bear)
clips.desc: An unstoppable shield charge through everyone in the way.

clips.label: Double-Headed Wolf
clips.desc: Ninja and bonded dog fuse into a giant wolf for about a minute: both hit far harder, take less damage and move faster. The dog is pulled to the user's side.

clips.label: Kisuzume (Chakra Sparrows)
clips.desc: Five sparrows of chakra fly out and spot every enemy within 60 cells, lifting the fog around them. Needs the ANBU falcon or owl mask worn.

clips.label: Gosei Ryuu: Ka-ryūsen (Air Dragon Strike)
clips.desc: Cut the air itself: a blade of wind flies out and hits everyone in a narrow line. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Gosei Ryuu: Ryūsōsen (Dragon's Nest Strike)
clips.desc: A flurry of blows at god-like speed on one enemy. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Gosei Ryuu: Ryusen (Dragon Strike)
clips.desc: Step back and cut a sphere of air in front: everyone in it is cut. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Tree Tomb
clips.desc: Bury every enemy in an area under living wood.

clips.label: Bedrock Coffin
clips.desc: Seal one enemy in a coffin of stone for fifteen seconds.

clips.label: Sabaku Kyuu: Sand Coffin
clips.desc: Wrap one enemy in a coffin of sand for ten seconds.

clips.label: Sabaku Taisou: Imperial Funeral
clips.desc: Bury a whole area under the desert.

clips.label: Monolith: Black Drizzle
clips.desc: Iron sand rains over a wide area for five seconds.

clips.label: Stalagmite Forest
clips.desc: A forest of stone spears erupts over a wide area for ten seconds.

clips.label: Katon: Great Fireball
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile NF_GreatFireball: painted flight SigFireballFlight (4 frames, on True), flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 34, impacts 0]  [storm starts 1 (last NF_GreatFireball_1)]
clips.desc: The Uchiha rite of passage: a huge ball of fire. The S-rank version is larger and hotter.

clips.label: Katon: Great Fire Annihilation
clips.desc: A sea of fire washes over a wide arc in front of the user.

clips.label: Battle Ready (Sharingan)
clips.desc: Read the flow of the fight for half an hour: better dodging and accuracy. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Mirror Heaven and Earth Change
clips.desc: For ten seconds the user turns most of the force of incoming attacks back on nothing.

clips.label: Painful Stare
clips.desc: Meet an enemy's eyes and fill them with phantom pain for a minute. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Shackling Stakes
clips.desc: Pin a foe with genjutsu stakes: real wounds, a long stun. Needs the Sharingan active. (Builds on Stakes: learn Stakes first; it replaces it.)

clips.label: Burning Stare
clips.desc: The victim burns from the inside for half a minute. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Fatiguing Stare
clips.desc: Every enemy in a small area slows to a crawl for a minute. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Batch 8: fire and the first stares
clips.scene: Batch 8: fire and the first stares

clips.label: Demoralizing Stare
clips.desc: Visions of defeat for every enemy in an area: worse aim and dulled minds for a minute. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Wilting Stare
clips.desc: Genjutsu: one enemy withers, slowed, dazed and burning for a minute. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Majestic Stare
clips.desc: Every enemy in a wide area freezes in awe for eight seconds. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Gazing Genjutsu
clips.desc: Trap one enemy in an illusion. They collapse, lost, for twenty seconds. Needs the Sharingan active.

clips.label: Telescopic Eye
clips.desc: Focus the Byakugan for half an hour of far sharper shooting. Needs the Byakugan active.

clips.label: Harichakra: Chakra Needles
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile NF_ChakraNeedle: painted flight none, flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 26, impacts 0]  [storm starts 1 (last NF_ChakraNeedle_1)]
clips.desc: Fire needles of solid chakra. The great version is a single heavy needle.

clips.label: Hakke: Chakra Transfer Palm
clips.desc: Pass chakra into an ally through the palm, closing wounds.

clips.label: Chakra no Bodi: Body of Chakra
clips.desc: Coat the whole body in chakra for ten minutes: tougher, faster to dodge, harder hitting.

clips.label: Batch 9: great stares and the clear eye
clips.scene: Batch 9: great stares and the clear eye

clips.label: Hakke Kūshō: Eight Trigrams Empty Palm
clips.desc: A palm strike of pure air that hits and throws back enemies in a line.

clips.label: Jūken Tenketsu: Gentle Fist Chakra Points
clips.desc: Strike the tenketsu, sealing chakra points so the target moves and fights worse for two minutes. Needs the Byakugan active.

clips.label: Hakkeshō: Great Divination Whirl
clips.desc: A larger Rotation that hits and hurls away everyone close by.

clips.label: Hakke Hasangeki: Eight Trigrams Mountain Crusher
clips.desc: A massive palm blast of chakra that flattens everything in a wide arc.

clips.label: Hakke: One Hundred Twenty-Eight Palms
clips.desc: A blinding chain of palm strikes on one enemy that seals their chakra network. Needs the Byakugan active. (Builds on Sixty-Four Palms: learn it first; this replaces it.)

clips.label: Shugohakke: Protection of the Sixty-Four Palms
clips.desc: For a minute, a sphere of chakra blades cuts anyone who comes close.

clips.label: Shinkan: Silence Gates
clips.desc: Close the target's chakra gates one after another. Each rank seals deeper. Needs the Byakugan active.

clips.label: Hakke Hazan Hōgeki: Crumbling Mountain Bombardment
clips.desc: A rain of chakra palm blasts over an area for five seconds.

clips.label: Shugohakke: Protection of the White God
clips.desc: A towering chakra avatar guards the user for a minute and strikes everything nearby.

clips.label: Mushi Ryūki: Bug Projection
clips.desc: Pour a line of kikaichū at the enemy. They bite and feed on chakra. The double line is wider and hungrier.

clips.label: Mushitate: Bug Shield
clips.why: the enemy's throws struck the barrier (3 stopped, 5 reached the caster)
clips.desc: A wall of kikaichū around the user catches incoming shots.

clips.label: Bug Grappling
clips.desc: Bugs swarm over one enemy's limbs and hold them. The extension reaches further and holds longer.

clips.label: Poison Reduction
clips.desc: The kikaichū filter the blood for a day: far better against toxins and disease.

clips.label: Yoroi no Mushi: Armour of Bugs
clips.desc: Cover the body in bugs for half an hour: they soak blows and bite anyone adjacent.

clips.label: Genwaku Mushiheki: Blinding Bug Burst
clips.desc: A burst of bugs over an area covers every enemy's eyes for half a minute.

clips.label: Mushikabe: Bug Wall
clips.why: the enemy's throws struck the barrier (3 stopped)
clips.desc: A large dome of bugs around a spot blocks enemy shots for twenty-five seconds or until broken.

clips.label: Mushi Ame: Bug Rain
clips.desc: Bugs pour down over an area, biting everything for five seconds.

clips.label: Batch 11: insect swarms, lines and guards
clips.scene: Batch 11: insect swarms, lines and guards

clips.label: Mushi Kōchisho: Bug Prison
clips.desc: Seal one enemy in a ball of bugs: held, bitten and drained.

clips.label: Hitoshirezu Mushiryūdan: Hidden Bug Dragon
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile NF_BugDragon_One: painted flight SigBugDragonFlight (4 frames, on True), flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 26, impacts 0]  [storm starts 1 (last NF_BugDragon_One)]
clips.desc: A dragon-shaped mass of bugs slams into the target area. Larger with each rank.

clips.label: Mushi Kiri: Bug Mist
clips.desc: Surround the user with a haze of insects for a minute that bites anyone close.

clips.label: Mushi Kachū: Bug Vortex
clips.desc: A spinning column of bugs traps every enemy in an area and drains them.

clips.label: Yūen Mushinami: Grand Bug Wave
clips.desc: A wave of countless insects floods a wide arc.

clips.label: Mishu Arano: Bug Wasteland
clips.desc: The ground becomes a seething field of bugs for ten seconds.

clips.label: Canine Bond
clips.desc: Bond with a tamed dog (or any other canine your colony owns). The dog becomes this ninja's partner and fights with the clan techniques.

clips.label: Keen Senses
clips.desc: While on: sharper hearing and sight, harder to catch off guard.

clips.label: Four Legs Technique
clips.desc: Drop into a beast stance: faster, harder to hit and better at landing blows for about an hour.

clips.label: Piercing Fang
clips.desc: Spin like a drill along a line, tearing into everyone in the way. From Double Piercing Fang on, a bonded dog spins alongside and everyone in the way is hit once more for each.

clips.label: Pack Tactics
clips.desc: The user and every bonded dog on the map fight as a pack for about an hour.

clips.label: Hound of the Baskervilles
clips.desc: Drive every bonded dog on the map into a rage: harder bites, half the pain, for about half an hour.

clips.label: Fearful Howl
clips.desc: A bloodcurdling howl: enemies within eight cells flinch and are shaken (worse aim, slower) for half a minute.

clips.label: Paralysis Bite
clips.desc: A savage bite that locks the target's muscles for two seconds.

clips.label: Veterinarian
clips.desc: Bring a dog back to life, if it died within the last day.

clips.label: Bone Armour
clips.desc: While on, the user's bones harden into armour under the skin. Four stages: Stone, Iron, Exoskeleton of Undeath and Adamantine Bones.

clips.label: Dance of the Larch
clips.desc: Push bone spurs out of the body for half an hour: harder melee, and enemies standing next to the user are cut every second.

clips.label: Dance of the Clematis
clips.desc: Draw a huge weapon from the spine for a minute of devastating melee.

clips.label: Deathless
clips.desc: While on, the user's wounds close quickly. Drains chakra fast.

clips.label: Ten Finger Bullets
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile NF_BoneBullet: painted flight none, flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 22, impacts 0]  [storm starts 1 (last NF_FingerBullets_1)]
clips.desc: Fire the bones of the fingertips like bullets: five at a time. Burrowing Bony Digits dig in deeper.

clips.label: Bone Shards
clips.desc: A spray of sharp bone in a cone. Greater Bone Shards reach further and cut deeper.

clips.label: Batch 14: bone armour, dances and bullets
clips.scene: Batch 14: bone armour, dances and bullets

clips.label: Bone's Vengeful Grasp
clips.desc: Small bony hands burst from the ground and grab every enemy in a small area: a moment stuck, then slowed for ten seconds.

clips.label: Stillbone
clips.desc: Lock a target's bones in place: they can't move for six seconds.

clips.label: Bone Cage
clips.desc: An interlocking cage of bone traps every enemy in an area for ten seconds.

clips.label: Osteophage
clips.desc: Shatter the bones inside a nearby target.

clips.label: Dance of the Seedling Ferns
clips.desc: A forest of bone spikes erupts over a wide area and keeps stabbing for five seconds.

clips.label: Kagemane no Jutsu: Shadow Imitation
clips.desc: Stretch the user's shadow along the ground to the target and lock them in place. Higher ranks reach further and hold longer.

clips.label: Shadow Strike
clips.desc: The user's shadow punches the target's shadow, and the blow lands on the body.

clips.label: Batch 15: bone binds and the shadow's reach
clips.scene: Batch 15: bone binds and the shadow's reach

clips.label: Kage Kubi Shibari: Shadow Neck Bind
clips.desc: Hold the target with a shadow and choke them: they cannot move, struggle to breathe and take damage every second.

clips.label: Shadow Entrapment
clips.desc: Shadow tendrils wrap one target completely and hold them for fifteen seconds.

clips.label: Shadow Blast
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile NF_ShadowKunai: painted flight none, flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 34, impacts 0]  [storm starts 1 (last NF_ShadowBlast_1)]
clips.desc: Fire a sharpened beam of shadow: a kunai at C rank, a spear at B rank.

clips.label: Shadow Envelop
clips.desc: Wrap the user in shadows that soften blows and blades for half an hour.

clips.label: Kage Nui: Shadow Sewing
clips.desc: Shadow threads stab and pin up to six enemies in an area.

clips.label: Shadow Dome
clips.why: the enemy's throws struck the barrier (3 stopped)
clips.desc: Raise a dome of shadow on a spot: enemy shots can't get in for twenty seconds.

clips.label: Shadow Endgame
clips.desc: Every enemy in a wide area is caught by razor-sharp shadows: held still and cut apart.

clips.label: Batch 16: shadow binds, blades and dome
clips.scene: Batch 16: shadow binds, blades and dome

clips.label: Bubun Baika: Partial Expansion
clips.desc: Swell one arm to giant size and swing it at a nearby enemy.

clips.label: Baika no Jutsu: Expansion
clips.desc: Grow to giant size: stronger, tougher, slower. Each rank grows larger.

clips.label: Nikudan Sensha: Human Bullet Tank
clips.desc: Roll into a giant ball and flatten everyone in a line. The spiked version also stabs.

clips.label: Calorie Control
clips.desc: Burn stored calories into chakra and toughness for an hour.

clips.label: Ironguts
clips.desc: Harden the body for a day against toxins, rot and disease.

clips.label: Chōbaika: Mega Palm Thrust
clips.desc: Expand both hands and slam them down on an area.

clips.label: Chō Mode: Butterfly Mode
clips.desc: Burn fat into a vast surge of chakra: wings of light and enormous strength for one minute.

clips.label: Impact Wave
clips.desc: A giant fist strike that sends a shockwave rolling across the battlefield.

clips.label: Batch 17: swelling bodies and heavy blows
clips.scene: Batch 17: swelling bodies and heavy blows

clips.label: Mind Pulse
clips.desc: A pulse of mental chakra dazes every enemy in a small area.

clips.label: Confusion
clips.desc: Scramble one enemy's thoughts: they wander off in a daze.

clips.label: Mind Imprisonment
clips.desc: Lock an enemy inside their own mind: they freeze where they stand.

clips.label: Broken Mind
clips.desc: Shatter an enemy's focus for two minutes.

clips.label: Shinranshin no Jutsu: Mind Body Disturbance
clips.desc: Seize control of an enemy's body and turn them on their own side.

clips.label: Shintenshin no Jutsu: Mind Body Switch
clips.desc: Send your mind into an enemy's body and fight with it for half a minute. Your own body falls limp meanwhile, so keep it guarded. If the borrowed body falls while you are in it, your mind comes back badly shaken.

clips.label: Kontanribon no Jutsu: Mind Ribbon
clips.desc: Ribbons of mind chakra bind up to three enemies in an area.

clips.label: Omoitobikomi no Jutsu: Mind Dive
clips.desc: Plunge into an enemy's mind and tear through it: heavy damage to thought itself.

clips.label: Omoi Dōran Odori: Mind Disturbance Dance
clips.desc: Throw every enemy in an area into confusion: they wander off, dazed.

clips.label: Dancing Minds
clips.desc: Seize the minds of every enemy in a wide area and set them against each other.

clips.label: Samehada: Shark Skin
clips.desc: Toughen the skin into rasping shark hide for an hour: tougher, and every blow bites deeper.

clips.label: Suikōdan: Water Shark Bullet
clips.why: the target wasn't affected  [projectile NF_WaterShark: painted flight SigWaterSharkFlight (4 frames, on True), flier drawn 0/0, comet 0, signature steps 0, flights at launch 0; launched 26, impacts 0]  [storm starts 1 (last NF_WaterShark_1)]
clips.desc: Fire a shark of water that bursts on impact. Hammerhead Missile and Great White Shark are bigger.

clips.label: Suiton: Bakurai: Depth Charge
clips.desc: Hurl a heavy charge of water that bursts over a small area.

clips.label: Samekabe: Shark Wall
clips.why: the enemy's throws struck the barrier (3 stopped)
clips.desc: A circling wall of water sharks around a spot blocks enemy shots for twenty seconds.

clips.label: Chi Kaori: Blood Scent
clips.desc: Smell blood in the water: lock onto a wounded foe and bite hard.

clips.label: Suiton: Satsugai Naiō: Killing Depths
clips.desc: Flood an area with crushing deep water for six seconds.

clips.label: Same Kyōran: Shark Frenzy
clips.desc: Give in to the shark. One minute of savage strength, speed and bloodthirst.

clips.label: Doken Tsuiseki (Earthen Tracking Hounds)
clips.desc: Tracking hounds burst from the ground and pin the target, which stays marked and slowed for a while. Needs the ANBU falcon mask worn.

clips.label: Chiato (Blood Trail)
clips.desc: Mark an enemy with its own blood: it is slowed and easy to follow for a long time. Needs the ANBU falcon mask worn.

clips.label: Kowadori (Voice Capture)
clips.desc: Steal the target's voice: it can't speak or call out for a while. Needs the ANBU falcon or owl or wolf mask worn.

clips.label: Raihō (Thunder Cannon)
clips.desc: A straight line of lightning bursts from the palm. Hits anyone in the line, allies too. Needs the ANBU falcon mask worn.

clips.label: Rairō (Lightning Cage)
clips.desc: Six pillars of lightning lock around the target. It can't move or fight for several seconds and is numb after. Needs the ANBU falcon mask worn.

clips.label: Seihaku Rai (Pale Bolt)
clips.desc: A single, lightning-fast bolt from the fingertip that pierces armour. Needs the ANBU falcon or cat mask worn.

clips.label: Seijaku no Maru (Silence Dome)
clips.desc: A dome where no sound escapes: enemies inside are silenced. Needs the ANBU falcon or cat mask worn.

clips.label: Otomaku (Sound Veil)
clips.desc: A genjutsu hides every sound the user makes: harder to pin down, quicker on the feet. Needs the ANBU owl or cat mask worn.

clips.label: Batch 20: ANBU tracking, lightning and silence
clips.scene: Batch 20: ANBU tracking, lightning and silence

clips.label: Kodama Obiki (Echo Lure)
clips.desc: Replay a recorded voice from somewhere else: enemies around the spot are confused for a while. Needs the ANBU owl mask worn.

clips.label: Jishinken (Earthquake Fist)
clips.desc: A chakra-loaded punch into the ground. The earth heaves around the user, hitting everyone nearby, allies too. Needs the ANBU bear mask worn.

clips.label: Kijishaku Wana (Chakra Magnet Trap)
clips.desc: A patch of sticky chakra on the ground: enemies who touch it can barely move. Needs the ANBU bear mask worn.

clips.label: Kitoride (Chakra Bulwark)
clips.desc: A barrier of pure chakra in front of the user: damage taken is cut sharply for a short time. Needs the ANBU bear or frog mask worn.

clips.label: Sōheki (Twin Barrier)
clips.desc: Two linked barriers shield every ally near the user from much of the damage they take. Needs the ANBU bear mask worn.

clips.label: Kakure Ashi (Unseen Step)
clips.desc: The user moves unseen and unheard for a short time. Needs the ANBU cat mask worn.

clips.label: Senbon Sōsa (Senbon Control)
clips.desc: A chakra-guided needle flies with deadly precision. Needs the ANBU cat mask worn.

clips.label: Wana Kakushi (Trap Concealment)
clips.desc: Lay a hidden spread of caltrops on a spot. Needs the ANBU cat mask worn.

clips.label: Batch 21: ANBU echoes, earth, barriers and stealth
clips.scene: Batch 21: ANBU echoes, earth, barriers and stealth

clips.label: Yakusō no Chie (Herbal Lore)
clips.desc: ANBU field medicine: for a day the user tends wounds better and faster. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Iyashi no Ki (Healing Aura)
clips.desc: C/A-rank. An aura that slowly closes the target's wounds. C heals light wounds, A heals deep ones. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Mamori no Ki (Protection Aura)
clips.desc: C/A-rank. An aura that turns blows aside. C softens them, A deflects even blades. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Dokuyoke (Poison Ward)
clips.desc: C/A-rank. An aura that burns poison out of the target. A also clears disease. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Kanzen Yōkai (Complete Meltdown)
clips.desc: Blindingly fast strikes and a chakra jab to the neck: the target sees five ANBU at once and runs in terror. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Fūmin (Confined Sleep)
clips.desc: A dance of wave links to the eyes, then a touch: the target's limbs fall asleep one by one. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Kekkai Kurai no Honō (Barrier-Eating Flames)
clips.desc: Five purple flames that eat away enemy barriers, walls and domes on the spot. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Shinkeitō (Nerve Blade)
clips.desc: An assassin's blade of chakra from the wrist that severs the nerves. Huge damage, a long stun. Needs the ANBU frog mask worn.

clips.label: Batch 22: ANBU field medicine and assassin's arts
clips.scene: Batch 22: ANBU field medicine and assassin's arts

clips.label: Shōgeki no Shinjitsu (Shocking Truth)
clips.desc: C/B/A-rank. Lightning from the hands into a target in reach. Painful enough to loosen any tongue. Needs the ANBU wolf mask worn.

clips.label: Shinshō (Stun Palm)
clips.desc: A thousand volts through the palms into a target in reach. A long stun.

clips.label: Dokushin (Mind Reading)
clips.desc: Read a prisoner's thoughts while questioning them: their resistance to recruitment is halved. Needs the ANBU wolf mask worn.

clips.label: Kioku Keshi (Manual Amnesia)
clips.desc: B/A/S-rank. The user forces themselves to forget. B: the three worst memories. A: every bad memory. S: every bad memory, and it ends a mental break.

clips.label: Noroi Ningyō (Curse Doll)
clips.desc: A clay doll made with something of the target's: it suffers pain and dizziness for a long time.

clips.label: Kanashibari
clips.desc: The basic ANBU paralysis: the target freezes in place for a few seconds.

clips.label: Kyōonpa (Violent Sound Wave)
clips.desc: A clap that sends a stunning wave of sound forward. Hits anyone in it, allies too.

clips.label: Kan'on (Shrill Tone)
clips.desc: A piercing tone over a wide area: enemies are deafened and dazed.

clips.label: Batch 23: ANBU: questioning and the mind
clips.scene: Batch 23: ANBU: questioning and the mind

clips.label: Kinawa Shibari (Chakra Rope Binding)
clips.desc: A rope of chakra lashes out and binds the target's arms and legs.

clips.label: Bōkyaku no Ori (Cage of the Forgotten)
clips.desc: A red diamond seal traps the target; it can't move and its chakra drains away.

clips.label: Kitejō (Chakra Cuffs)
clips.desc: Hands locked behind the back with shackles of chakra: the target can barely move or fight.

clips.label: Guren Kadama (Crimson Fireball)
clips.desc: C/B/A/S-rank. An orb of chakra bursts into flame and explodes on the target.

clips.label: Sōao Hōkiboshi (Twin Blue Comets)
clips.desc: Two blue fire comets at once burn a wide path ahead. Hits anyone in the way, allies too.

clips.label: Yōkai Kiri (Dissolving Mist)
clips.desc: After a long gathering of chakra, a mist eats at everything solid around the user, allies too.

clips.label: Shitai Shobun (Body Disposal)
clips.desc: Blue flames in a small circle burn corpses away without even ash.

clips.label: Shitai Hozon (Body Conservation)
clips.desc: A shell of chakra keeps nearby corpses from rotting, as fresh as the hour they died.

clips.label: Batch 24: ANBU: binds and burning
clips.scene: Batch 24: masked guard, binds and burning

clips.label: Kanpeki Nage (Perfect Throw)
clips.desc: Chakra threads guide every thrown weapon: aim faster and truer for a while.

clips.label: Tsuiseki no Jutsu (Tracking Technique)
clips.desc: Read the traces left behind: every enemy within 80 cells is revealed.

clips.label: Don the Mask
clips.desc: Put on the ANBU mask for a day: steady nerves, sharper skill.

clips.label: Smoke Escape
clips.desc: Vanish into a cloud of smoke at the user's feet: the user is unseen for a moment while the smoke is thick.

clips.label: Shadow Stealth
clips.desc: Melt into the shadows for half a minute.

clips.label: Shadow Squad
clips.desc: Hide every friend in a wide circle in shadow for half a minute.

clips.label: Tanto Flash
clips.desc: Flash through a line of enemies with a short blade.

clips.label: Silent Kill
clips.desc: One silent, killing strike. An enemy below half health dies outright; one caught unaware is struck in the neck or heart.

clips.label: Burning Legs
clips.desc: Heat the legs red-hot for a fight: kicks only, and they burn.

clips.label: Searing Shin
clips.desc: A red-hot shin kick to one enemy.

clips.label: Flaming Axe Kick
clips.desc: A heel dropped like an axe on one enemy.

clips.label: Burning Sky Step
clips.desc: Kick off the air and through a line of enemies.

clips.label: Burning Whirl
clips.desc: A spinning burning kick around the user.

clips.label: Crimson Inferno Kick
clips.desc: Every bit of heat poured into one kick.

clips.label: Battōjutsu (Art of Drawing the Blade)
clips.desc: A lightning-fast draw-cut on one enemy.

clips.label: Hanabira Surasshu (Petal Slash)
clips.desc: A draw-cut followed by a scatter of quick slashes across everyone in front.

clips.label: Kagenui (Shadow Stitch)
clips.desc: Flash past one enemy and cut them from behind.

clips.label: Shidensen (Purple Lightning Flash)
clips.desc: A draw-cut wreathed in lightning that stuns one enemy.

clips.label: Sakura Tsuisutā (Sakura Twister)
clips.desc: A spinning draw-cut that slashes everyone around you.

clips.label: Fureā (Flare)
clips.desc: A spiralling cut that strikes every enemy around you.

clips.label: Gosei Ryuu: Wisdom Dragon Stance
clips.desc: Hold the Wisdom Dragon for a fight. Gosei techniques hit harder, and you hit a Genkai fighter harder. Only one Kenseijin stance at a time. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Genkai Ryuu: Courage Dragon Stance
clips.desc: Hold the Courage Dragon for a fight. Genkai techniques hit harder, and you hit a Tsuyosa fighter harder. Only one Kenseijin stance at a time. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Tsuyosa Ryuu: Power Dragon Stance
clips.desc: Hold the Power Dragon for a fight. Tsuyosa techniques hit harder, and you hit a Gosei fighter harder. Only one Kenseijin stance at a time. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Genkai Ryuu: Jinsokugeiru (Rapid Gale)
clips.desc: A double slash, one way and back again. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Genkai Ryuu: Herumukatsu (Crown Splitter)
clips.desc: Leap and bring the blade down on one enemy's head hard enough to split a helmet. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Genkai Ryuu: Issen (Flash)
clips.desc: One counter-cut that kills most enemies outright. (Needs a bladed weapon.)

clips.label: Tsuyosa Ryuu: Gufuukakou (Tornado Drop)
clips.desc: Grab one enemy, spin up into the air and drive them into the ground. (Needs a melee weapon.)

clips.label: Tsuyosa Ryuu: Kaisoku (Quick of Foot)
clips.desc: A counter that strips one enemy of their weapon. (Needs a melee weapon.)

clips.label: Tsuyosa Ryuu: Nijuu no Kiwami (Twofold Strike)
clips.desc: Two blows land as one, the second passing straight through armour. (Needs a melee weapon.)
